posts.title: Joystick Switchers Review
posts.description: Tired of the C64 joystick port lottery, or tempted to plug in a MegaDrive pad without risking your SID? I tested SharewarePlus’s Joystick Switcher and Mega Switcher on my C64C and C64 Ultimate. They give you one-button port switching, adjustable auto-fire, hardware button remapping, and diode protection that makes Sega pads safe to use. Both come fully built, tested and boxed for £24. posts.title: ComHub 64 USB Hub Review
posts.description: A review of the ComHub 64, a 3D printed replica of the Commodore 1541 floppy drive that doubles as a USB extension cable — a fun, nostalgic solution to the awkward rear USB ports on the C64 Ultimate. The post ComHub 64 USB Hub Review appeared first on Lyonsden Blog .

posts.title: How to use FTP on your C64 Ultimate
posts.description: The C64 Ultimate has a built-in FTP server, making it easy to transfer D64s, SID files, cartridge images and more directly from your modern computer. Here's how to get it up and running in just a few minutes. The post How to use FTP on your C64 Ultimate appeared first on Lyonsden Blog .
